prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic editorial street-fashion portrait at an outdoor cafe. An adult woman sits centered on a chrome cafe chair with calm direct eye contact, sleek glossy black hair in a precise center-parted low bun, small earrings, and layered pearl-and-chain necklaces. She wears a structured charcoal tweed jacket with subtle texture and small gold buttons over a black top, plus a long dark draped skirt and metallic silver pointed-toe heels. On the round cafe table: a white espresso cup on a saucer and an unbranded black soft-pouch handbag with a gold chain strap. Behind her, a passing train becomes strong horizontal motion-blur streaks in off-white, teal-blue, and gray while she remains sharp. Light stone pavement, soft diffused daylight, 85mm perspective compression, visible fabric weave, natural pores, gentle grain, and muted luxury color grading.
